roadmap.title: Story and early fights
roadmap.description: Play the story on any difficulty and clear the prologue plus all 13 chapter completions while the first Majima encounters and early abilities arrive. The story achievements are automatic and nothing here is missable.

roadmap.title: Majima Everywhere
roadmap.description: Drive the Majima rank from G to SSS: complete every rank-up event, Nishida e-mail ability, surprise ambush and forced fight, then win the final showdown to upgrade all Majima abilities.

roadmap.title: Substories
roadmap.description: Complete all 78 substories, including the seven with their own achievements, and finish the Amon chain.

roadmap.title: Komaki training and coliseum
roadmap.description: Win the coliseum tournaments to fund Komaki's 11 training moves, then buy every Soul, Technique and Body ability with XP.

roadmap.title: Hostess clubs and minigames
roadmap.description: Max both hostess clubs, date a hostess over Mahjong, and clear Pocket Circuit, MesuKing and every minigame.

roadmap.title: Completion List cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the remaining Completion List counters until the list reaches 50% and then 100%.

roadmap.title: Premium Adventure and endgame challenges
roadmap.description: Walk 1 km holding Haruka's hand, clear Haruka's Requests to EX Rank, defeat Amon and finish all Climax Battles.

roadmap.title: Legend playthrough and final achievement
roadmap.description: Replay the story on Legend difficulty from a New Game+ save and claim the completion reward once every other achievement is earned.

achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement in the game.

guide.context: The final reward has no separate requirement; it is granted once the other 54 entries are already earned.

steps.text: Complete all 54 other achievements; this reward unlocks as the last outstanding one is earned.

achievements.summary: Complete 50% of the in-game Completion List on one save file.

guide.context: The list lives under Pause Menu > Completion List and spans five areas: Adventure, Battle, Substories, Minigames and Majima Everywhere. Percentages only count on a single save file, but leftover content can be finished in Premium Adventure after the story.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Pause Menu} > @mechanic{Completion List} and clear counters as you play the story.
Keep finishing counters until the list passes 50%; the achievement pops as the meter crosses that mark.

achievements.summary: Complete 100% of the in-game Completion List on one save file.

guide.context: Seven lists must be finished, including the two character-specific minigame lists. This is the longest achievement in the game; do it in @mechanic{Premium Adventure}, where the whole map stays open after the story.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Premium Adventure}, open @mechanic{Pause Menu} > @mechanic{Completion List} and finish the Adventure counters, such as talking to 300 people, dining 100 times, entertaining yourself 100 times and travelling 100 km on foot.

Clear the Battle counters: defeat 500 street enemies and 200 with each of @mechanic{Brawler}, @mechanic{Rush}, @mechanic{Beast} and @mechanic{Dragon}, use 300 Heat Actions and complete the weapon and gear collections.
Finish all 78 substories and every Majima Everywhere counter.
Clear every minigame counter, including all Pocket Circuit races and the MesuKing card set, then confirm the list reads 100%.

achievements.summary: Get chased by Majima during his Chapter 2 introduction.

guide.context: Majima Everywhere opens shortly into Chapter 2, when Majima beats Kiryu in a scripted fight and then hunts him across Kamurocho. Nothing about this chase can be skipped.

steps.text: Play Chapter 2 until Majima ambushes and chases Kiryu; the achievement unlocks during that sequence.

achievements.description: Thug Majima forced his way into a fight.
achievements.summary: Have Thug-style Majima barge into a street fight.

guide.context: This is a Don't Forget Majima event. The target looks like an ordinary enemy but speaks a few lines before the fight, and Majima enters once he takes a few hits. Majima must be active in the city, and entering and leaving a nearby building rerolls the spawn.

steps.text: Lower your Heat so the @mechanic{Majima Sensor} is active, then wait near the Tenkaichi Poppo or on Shichifuku St. just north of the Todo Building.
Bump into the idle man in the tan jacket, let him finish talking, then strike him a few times so Thug Majima enters the battle.
Win the fight.
steps.note: If nothing spawns, walk into a nearby building and back out to reroll the street.

achievements.description: Slugger Majima forced his way into a fight.
achievements.summary: Have Slugger-style Majima barge into a street fight.

guide.context: This is a Don't Forget Majima event: a special thug speaks for a moment before the fight, then Majima joins in. Keep Majima active and reroll the area by entering and leaving a building.

steps.text: Go to the corner south-west of where the @loc{Champion District}'s south entrance sits, or stand outside @loc{Children's Park}.
Bump the idle thug, hear him out, then hit him so Slugger Majima joins the fight.
Win the fight.
steps.note: Enter and leave a building to reroll the spawn if the thug does not appear.

achievements.description: Breaker Majima forced his way into a fight.
achievements.summary: Have Breaker-style Majima barge into a street fight.

guide.context: This is a Don't Forget Majima event: a special thug talks before the fight and Majima enters once he takes a few hits. Majima must be active; entering and leaving a building rerolls the spawn.

steps.text: Go to where @loc{Shichifuku St.} ends in the east, or to the theater itself on the south-east side of @loc{Theater Square}.
Bump the idle thug, wait for his dialogue, then strike him a few times so Breaker Majima joins in.
Win the fight.
steps.note: Reroll by walking in and out of a nearby building if needed.

achievements.description: The Mad Dog of Shimano forced his way into a fight.
achievements.summary: Have Mad Dog Majima barge into a street fight.

guide.context: This is a Don't Forget Majima event: a special thug with sunglasses talks before the fight, then Majima joins. Mad Dog is Majima's dagger style, so bring healing and watch for his flips. Majima must be active and the spawn rerolls when you enter or leave a building.

steps.text: Go just outside @loc{Millennium Tower} and walk in and out of the @loc{Taihei Akaushimaru}, or stand east of @loc{Mach Bowl}.
Bump the man in the black jacket with sunglasses, hear him out, then hit him so Mad Dog Majima joins in.
Win the fight.

achievements.description: Reached Rank B in Majima Everywhere.
achievements.summary: Reach Rank B in Majima Everywhere.

guide.context: Rank starts at G and caps at SSS. The gauge fills from street fights, ambushes, hidden-Majima spots and minigame challenges, and Nishida calls once a rank is ready. Rank progress is story-gated: Rank G lasts until Chapter 4, Rank C until Chapter 8 and Rank B until Chapter 10.

steps.text: Fight and encounter Majima across @loc{Kamurocho} to fill the rank gauge.
When Nishida calls, follow the green map marker and complete the rank-up event.
Keep ranking up until the counter reaches B.
steps.note: If Nishida says Majima cannot be found, advance the story to lift the rank cap.

achievements.summary: Upgrade every Majima Everywhere ability in the Dragon style.

guide.context: Each Dragon-style ability tied to Majima Everywhere comes from a rank-up event or a Nishida e-mail challenge, and the last one appears only after 47 of the 48 abilities are unlocked. Maxing the rank to SSS and clearing Komaki's training are part of the same progression.

steps.text: Rank Majima up to SSS and complete every rank-up event and Nishida e-mail challenge to claim the Dragon abilities.
Beat Majima in the style each e-mail asks for, such as Thug, Slugger, Breaker and Mad Dog.
When Majima calls you to the @loc{Batting Center} for the last ability fight, win it to finish the set.

achievements.description: Spent a steamy moment with Yui.
achievements.summary: Complete Yui's substory at the JEWEL hostess club.

guide.context: Raise Yui from Rank F to Rank A to make substory 54, A Goodbye Promise, available. Wearing a Shirt-type item and ordering a drink each visit keeps the session meter high; skip gifts, because Yui sometimes rejects them.

steps.text: Visit @loc{JEWEL} at the MEB and hold good sessions with Yui until she reaches Rank A.
steps.note: Rank replies: F, mention time in prison and let the honesty stand. E, say men should respect a girl's feelings and that honesty is best. D, call them jerks, then suggest confessing love. C, call him odd and answer Either. B, agree it is possible and that she is already smitten. A, ask whether she will stay out of love, then say you look forward to it.

steps.text: At Rank A, complete substory 54, A Goodbye Promise.

achievements.description: Spent a steamy moment with Rina.
achievements.summary: Complete Rina's substory at the SHINE hostess club.

guide.context: Raise Rina from Rank F to Rank A to open substory 55, Freedom to Romance. Keep the session meter high by wearing a Shirt-type item and ordering a drink each visit.

steps.text: Visit @loc{SHINE} at the MEB and hold good sessions with Rina until she reaches Rank A.
steps.note: Rank replies: F, greet her as new and say she looks happy. E, say that is not really cheating and that attitudes differ overseas. D, tell her to date a man, then say she does not like herself. C, answer Either and ask whether she is cute. B, call it ridiculous, then raise adoption. A, agree, then ask whether someone specific is on her mind.

steps.text: At Rank A, complete substory 55, Freedom to Romance.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 substories.

guide.context: Substories unlock as the story advances, and some require Haruka to be present while others only start when Kiryu is alone.

steps.text: Finish any 10 substories; the achievement pops when the tenth completes.

achievements.summary: Complete 30 substories.

guide.context: There are 78 substories in total, and the @mechanic{Encounter Finder} marks them on the map once acquired.

steps.text: Finish 30 substories across the story and @mechanic{Premium Adventure}.

achievements.summary: Complete all 78 substories.

guide.context: The 78th entry is a secret boss substory that opens only after the other 77 are done, and it also needs every Dragon ability. Some substories require Haruka to be with you, while others, including Majima Everywhere battles, only trigger when Kiryu is alone.

steps.text: Use the @mechanic{Encounter Finder} to track down every substory and clear them as they unlock.
Switch between having Haruka accompany you and going solo so both kinds of substory can start.
Finish any stragglers in @mechanic{Premium Adventure} until all 78 are complete.

achievements.description: Completed all training for Komaki Style.
achievements.summary: Complete all 11 Komaki Style training lessons.

guide.context: The lessons are substories 59 to 69. Each later lesson needs a training item bought with Purgatory coliseum points, so win coliseum fights to fund them. Tiger Drop, the second-to-last unlock, makes the remaining lessons much easier.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Purgatory} and agree to become Komaki's pupil.
Win coliseum fights for points and buy the required items, including a @item{Wooden Katana} and the Image items.
Complete lessons 59 to 69 in order.
steps.note: Lesson 64 needs a well-timed dodge against Komaki's shotgun; lesson 68 unlocks Tiger Drop; lesson 69 is a duel with Komaki.

achievements.description: Obtained at least 10 Soul, Technique, and Body abilities.
achievements.summary: Obtain at least 10 abilities in each of the Soul, Technique and Body trees.

guide.context: Abilities are bought with XP in the upgrade menus. Story progress, substories and Majima fights all supply XP, so the requirement fills naturally during a normal run.

steps.text: Earn XP from the story, substories and Majima encounters.
Open the Abilities menu and buy at least 10 skills in the Soul, Technique and Body trees.

achievements.description: Obtained all Soul, Technique, and Body abilities.
achievements.summary: Obtain every Soul, Technique and Body ability.

guide.context: Every skill in the three non-Dragon trees must be bought with XP, so expect a long accumulation across the whole completion run.

steps.text: Earn XP throughout the story, substories and Majima fights.
Open the Abilities menu and purchase every skill in the Soul, Technique and Body trees until none remain locked.

achievements.description: Won all tournaments in the underground coliseum.
achievements.summary: Win every tournament in the Purgatory underground coliseum.

guide.context: The coliseum sits in Purgatory, and its prizes fund Komaki's training. Early fights pay well if you stack crowd-pleaser points by blocking and dodging, and some arenas allow an instant ring-out. Once Tiger Drop is learned it trivializes the later fights.

steps.text: Enter the coliseum in @loc{Purgatory} and clear the lower tournament rows.
Win the remaining tournaments, using @mechanic{Tiger Drop} for boss fights, a bat or brass knuckles for weapon rounds, and ring-outs where available.

achievements.description: Successfully asked a hostess out on a date.
achievements.summary: Ask a hostess out on a date and have her accept.

guide.context: The date option appears once a hostess reaches Rank D, and it costs only a little rank progress, so one successful date is enough. Choosing Mahjong as the date activity also sets up the Sexy Ron achievement.

steps.text: Raise Yui or Rina to Rank D through good hostess sessions.
After a strong session, pick the option to ask her on a date and complete it.

achievements.summary: Play Mahjong with a hostess during a date.

guide.context: Take either Yui or Rina out from Rank D onward and choose Mahjong when the date activity is offered. Winning is not required, only playing the match.

steps.text: Ask Yui or Rina out on a date.
Choose Mahjong as the activity and play the match to the end.

achievements.displayName: The Dragon of Pocket Circuit Reborn!
achievements.summary: Win every Pocket Circuit race.

guide.context: New parts unlock at the Pocket Circuit shop after each win, so upgrade steadily. Most tested builds avoid using boost entirely. Majima also issues three Pocket Circuit challenges along the way.

steps.text: Visit the @loc{Pocket Circuit Stadium} and win each race, buying fresh parts between events.
steps.note: Win Introductory Race, Little Racer Cup, Rookie Race, Beginner Cup, Amateur Cup, Standard Cup, Intermediate Cup, Advanced Cup, Pro-am Race, Elite Cup, Expert Race, Master Cup, Champion Cup and 2005 King of Speed Cup.

steps.text: Beat Hideki, Fighter and Takuma, plus Majima's three challenge races.

achievements.description: Won against all rivals in MesuKing.
achievements.summary: Defeat every rival in MesuKing.

guide.context: MesuKing is mostly luck-driven. Build a deck from high-power insect cards with matching abilities, and counter the opponent's likely strong hand; the Taunt ability forces the rival to commit first. The rival battles run through substories 53 and 70 to 78.

steps.text: Collect insect and ability cards from shops, the coliseum, loose pickups and substory rewards.
Win the Professor's escalating battles through substories 53 and 70 to 78, including the final throne match at 50 cards.

achievements.summary: Play every minigame at least once.

guide.context: The list covers Batting, Bowling, Darts, Pool, Shogi, Mahjong, Karaoke, MesuKing, Pocket Circuit, Photo Booth, UFO Catcher, Club Asia, Baccarat, Blackjack, Poker, Roulette, Cho-han, Cee-lo, Koi-koi and Oicho-kabu. Watching a Club Asia show counts and is the one most players miss.

steps.text: Play each minigame on the list at least once.
Watch a show at @loc{Club Asia} to cover the commonly missed entry.

achievements.description: Walked 1km during Premium Adventure while holding Haruka's hand.
achievements.summary: Walk 1 km while holding Haruka's hand in Premium Adventure.

guide.context: This only works in @mechanic{Premium Adventure}. Running and dashing break the handhold, so use normal walking speed. Equipping Even Goro's Beads helps keep street thugs from interrupting the walk.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Premium Adventure}, ask Haruka to accompany you at @loc{Serena}.
Walk up and down @loc{Kamurocho} at normal speed until the 1 km counter completes.
steps.note: Roughly 20 to 30 minutes of walking; running ends the handhold.

achievements.displayName: When You Don't Pay Your Debts...
achievements.description: Finish the prologue and collect the money owed.
achievements.summary: Collect the money owed at the start of the story.

guide.context: This is the opening prologue achievement; it is awarded automatically and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the opening prologue until Kiryu collects the debt; the achievement unlocks as the prologue ends.

achievements.displayName: Things Will Never Be the Same
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 1 of the story.

guide.context: Chapter achievements are awarded at the chapter end results screen and none of them can be missed.

steps.text: Play Chapter 1 through to its end results screen.

achievements.description: Clear the main story on Legend difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish every story chapter while playing on Legend difficulty.

guide.context: Start this run with New Game+ from the game-clear save and stock healing items first. It plays like Hard mode, but a defeat returns you to the last manual save, and saving from the menu is allowed.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{New Game+} on @mechanic{Legend} difficulty with a stocked inventory.
Play the whole story, saving before long fights and reloading the last save on any defeat.

achievements.description: Get ambushed by Majima from above.
achievements.summary: Get ambushed by Majima leaping from above.

guide.context: This is a Suddenly Majima event: Majima hides and drops on Kiryu when he nears the spot. He must be active in the city, and entering and leaving a nearby building rerolls the setup until the alert plays.

steps.text: Stand outside @loc{Beam}, or on @loc{Pink Street} midway between @loc{Shine} and the southern gate.
Enter and leave a building until the Majima alert sounds, then walk to the marked spot.
Take the ambush and win the fight.
steps.note: The Mahjong parlor is a convenient building for rerolls.

achievements.description: Get ambushed by Majima from a manhole.
achievements.summary: Get ambushed by Majima emerging from a manhole.

guide.context: This is a Suddenly Majima event, separate from the hidden-Majima manhole item. Majima must be active, and entering and leaving a building rerolls the area until the alert plays.

steps.text: Go into the @loc{Champion District} close to its south entrance, or to @loc{Tenkaichi St.} by the @loc{Kazama Family Office}.
Enter and leave a building until the Majima alert sounds, then step to the marked spot.
Take the ambush and win the fight.
steps.note: Use Serena to reroll near the Kazama Family Office.

achievements.summary: Meet Majima in disguise as the hostess Goromi at SHINE.

guide.context: Goromi comes from the Rank F Nishida e-mail titled Please help!, so it takes a filled rank gauge to appear. Accept the session at SHINE and answer Goromi as Majima expects.

steps.text: When a Nishida e-mail says Please help!, go to @loc{SHINE} and agree to a hostess session.
Answer Goromi by saying you know how she feels, offering to fight her, extending the session, saying you would rather be a hostess, then accepting.
Finish the session.

achievements.summary: Meet Officer Majima during a Majima Everywhere rank-up event.

guide.context: Officer Majima appears in the Rank G to F event. Nishida calls when the rank gauge is full; follow the green marker and win the fight. The costume is then unlocked for street patrols.

steps.text: When Nishida calls about a rank-up, go to the payphone outside @loc{Millennium Tower}.
Approach Officer Majima and win the @mechanic{Slugger} style fight.

achievements.summary: Meet Zombie Majima during a Majima Everywhere rank-up event.

guide.context: Zombie Majima appears in the Rank D to C event on Senryo Ave. Nishida calls once the gauge is full; the event runs through several waves, but Majima stays in Thug style throughout.

steps.text: When Nishida calls about a rank-up, go to the marked area on @loc{Senryo Ave.}
Fight through the zombie waves and beat Majima.

achievements.description: Finish The Price of an F-cup, substory 1.
achievements.summary: Complete substory 1, titled The Price of an F-cup.

guide.context: The substory starts on Pink Street south of Beam. Go along with the woman when she invites Kiryu, but turn down the drink she offers.

steps.text: Head south down @loc{Pink Street} from @loc{Beam} to trigger substory 1, titled The Price of an F-cup.
Agree to go with the woman, then refuse to drink when she offers.

achievements.description: Finish My Baby's a Showgirl, substory 2.
achievements.summary: Complete substory 2, titled My Baby's a Showgirl.

guide.context: This substory begins with a phone call from Yuya, so answer the phone when it rings and follow the marker.

steps.text: Wait for and answer the phone call from Yuya to start substory 2, My Baby's a Showgirl.
Play the substory through to its end.

achievements.description: Finish Bet On a Champ, substory 3.
achievements.summary: Complete substory 3, titled Bet On a Champ.

guide.context: Substory 3 needs Haruka with you. Bring her to Bantam to start the bet.

steps.text: Have Haruka accompany you, then go to @loc{Bantam} to trigger substory 3, Bet On a Champ.
Play the substory through to its end.

achievements.summary: Complete substory 4, titled The Yakuza's Wife.

guide.context: This one only triggers while Kiryu is alone. The Florist calls with the lead, so wait for the call without Haruka in the party.

steps.text: With no companion, wait for the Florist's phone call that starts substory 4, The Yakuza's Wife.
Play the substory through to its end.

achievements.summary: Complete substory 5, titled A Doctor's Duty.

guide.context: Substory 5 has two deliveries. First take convenience-store food to a boy west of the West Park entrance, then bring more food with Haruka to Public Park 3. The clinic is on the west side of the Akaushimaru building close to Theater Square, marked by a cartoon-nurse sign.

steps.text: Buy food from a convenience store and give it to the boy west of the @loc{West Park} entrance to start substory 5, A Doctor's Duty.
Take more food and bring Haruka along to @loc{Public Park 3}, which sits in Tenkaichi Alley.
Follow the lead to the clinic near @loc{Theater Square}, just west of the Akaushimaru, and finish the substory.

achievements.description: Finish the substory The Fake Mizuki's Truth.
achievements.summary: Complete the substory titled The Fake Mizuki's Truth.

guide.context: This substory begins at the Florist's room, so head there once the marker appears.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Florist's room} to trigger the substory The Fake Mizuki's Truth.
Play the substory through to its end.

achievements.description: Finish the substory Man on a Ledge.
achievements.summary: Complete the substory titled Man on a Ledge.

guide.context: This substory needs Haruka with you. It begins where Park Blvd meets the Hotel District, at a crowd gathered at the street's west end, and each reply must be picked as listed.

steps.text: With Haruka, head to the far west end of @loc{Park Blvd} and approach the crowd to start the substory Man on a Ledge.
Reply with Tell me what happened, then Who is Mizuki?, then Have you contacted her?, then how much money you have spent on her.
Play the substory through to its end.

achievements.description: Defeat Amon in the secret final substory.
achievements.summary: Defeat Amon in the secret final substory.

guide.context: Amon is substory 46, The Last Assassin, which opens only after 77 of the 78 substories are done and every Dragon ability is unlocked. Amon fights in two phases, and his spin attack can nearly kill Kiryu outright.

steps.text: Finish 77 substories and unlock all Dragon abilities to receive the message that starts the Amon substory.
Meet Amon and beat his first phase.
Beat his second phase, watching for the spin move and using @mechanic{Tiger Drop} or Heat Actions.

achievements.summary: Clear all 30 Climax Battles.

guide.context: Climax Battles unlock after the game is cleared once on any difficulty and are launched from the main menu, with no save file attached. They are split into Proving Grounds 1 to 10, Melee Battle 1 to 10, the five Mad Dog battles and the five Ultimate battles; the Ultimate set only opens once the other three groups are cleared.

steps.text: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Climax Battles} and clear the ten Proving Grounds.
Clear Melee Battles 1 to 10 and the five Mad Dog battles.
Clear the five Ultimate battles, which unlock last.
steps.note: Ultimate battles restore only 10 percent health between fights, so use Heat Actions and @mechanic{Tiger Drop}; exit the menu after wins so progress saves.

achievements.description: Reach EX Rank on Haruka's Requests.
achievements.summary: Reach EX Rank on Haruka's Requests in Premium Adventure.

guide.context: This is a Premium Adventure activity. Minigame cheat items found in lockers make the gambling and pool requests much easier, and failing a minigame request means leaving the area and re-entering before you can try it again.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Premium Adventure}, ask Haruka to accompany you, then work through her requests in order.

Buy the shop items she asks for: Protective Amulet (Don Quijote), Staminan Royale (Kotobuki Drugs), Beef Bowl (Akaushimaru), Natchan Orange (Poppo on Tenkaichi), Dog Food (Poppo on Nakamichi), Ramen (Kyushu No. 1), Wallet (Le Marche), Stone-cooked Bibimbap (Kanrai), Shake (Smile Burger), Carbonara (Pronto, day menu), Yakisoba (Poppo Showa), Sherbet (Yoronotaki), Onion Takoyaki (Gindaco), Yakisoba Bun (M Store), Abalone (Sushi Gin), Coffee (Cafe Alps) and a Gold Plate (Ebisu Pawn).
Win the gambling requests: 300 in Oicho-kabu, 1000 chips in Roulette, 500 in Cee-lo, 2000 chips in Poker, 800 in Cho-han, 3000 chips in Blackjack, 1000 in Koi-koi and 4000 chips in Baccarat.

Clear the minigame requests: 200 in Darts Count Up, 1000+ on the Normal batting course, a Photo Booth shot, 800 on Haruka's karaoke song, a MesuKing win, a UFO Catcher monkey plushie, three strikes in three frames at bowling, and wins at Four-Ball and Expert Rotation pool.
Finish the tougher repeats: 950 on Otometal MY LIFE, three splits in a Bowling split game and 1200+ on the Hard batting course.
Keep completing requests until the trust rank reaches EX; the achievement pops at EX Rank.
